old_text: Band I contributes 1,200 points. Band II, 1,500. Band III, 1,800. Band IV, 2,100. Band V, 2,400. Total from leveling at Level 500: 9,000 points. Threshold bonuses through Stage XIII total 9,100 points. Full lifetime pool through Stage XIII: approximately 18,100 points, spendable across sixty-three Sub-Stats, Throne excluded. The allotment was cut by two fifths from its original figures when the Sub-Stat count was consolidated from a hundred and twenty to sixty-four. The old pool was sized against a phantom count of twenty stats and produced an overabundance the ceiling could not absorb. The cut restores scarcity without making versatility a luxury.
note_text: Extended by R75-28-HOW_MUCH_SHEET (techniques law 2026-10-04): on a full card the re-cost also spends each unset Sub-Stat inside the re-costed totals along the Path, logged, Isaac's characters' by Isaac (R75-29-WHO_SPENDS_LEVEL_POINTS); a short card carries Primary totals and the peaks a scene will stress. The allotment, the trim and the Threshold grants stand.
